title: Add front/back nine subtotals and PDF leaderboard export

requirements.text: Display a subtotal for holes 1-9 (front nine) in each player's score entry card, calculating the sum of scores entered for holes 1 through 9

quotes: please add a subtotal for holes 1-9

acceptanceCriteria: Front nine subtotal appears in the golfer score entry card after hole 9
Subtotal updates automatically as scores are entered or modified
Subtotal is clearly labeled as 'Front 9' or 'Holes 1-9'

requirements.text: Display a subtotal for holes 10-18 (back nine) in each player's score entry card, calculating the sum of scores entered for holes 10 through 18

quotes: holes 10-18  for each players score input

acceptanceCriteria: Back nine subtotal appears in the golfer score entry card after hole 18
Subtotal updates automatically as scores are entered or modified
Subtotal is clearly labeled as 'Back 9' or 'Holes 10-18'
Back nine subtotal only displays when the event is configured for 18 holes

requirements.text: Add a PDF generation feature to the leaderboard view that exports the calculated standings to PDF format

quotes: generate a pdf of the leaderboard once it is calculated

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Generate PDF' or 'Export PDF' button appears on the leaderboard view
Clicking the button generates a PDF containing the complete leaderboard with all player standings
PDF includes tournament details (title, course, date)
PDF shows rankings, player names, gross scores, net scores, and Callaway adjustments
PDF formatting is clean and print-ready

constraints: Do not modify the backend Callaway scoring logic or data models
Maintain existing gross total calculation behavior
Subtotals are display-only and do not affect Callaway score calculations
nonGoals: Modifying the Callaway chart or scoring algorithm
Adding subtotals to the leaderboard breakdown view
Changing the existing PDF export functionality for standings
